// SubsystemInterface: canonical layout, generated by tools/header_adopt_lane.py from
// reverse/class_contracts/SubsystemInterface.json (variant data), then hand-extended with a
// declared-only default constructor and virtual destructor (retail's dtor is the out-of-line
// 0x001B4E74, the +0 vptr's slot 0; derived dtors chain to it, which the data-only class
// could not express). Constructor: retail's base constructor is the out-of-line 0x001B4E63
// (row ??0SubsystemInterface in subsystem/SubsystemInterface.cpp), and without the declaration
// each unit emits an implicit inline copy that is not retail's body.
// sizeof 12 (retail-access); class-key class (bytes).
#ifndef CANONICAL_SUBSYSTEMINTERFACE_H
#define CANONICAL_SUBSYSTEMINTERFACE_H

#include "../../../../reference/shims/bfme2_ascii/ascii_string.h"

class SubsystemInterface {
public:
    SubsystemInterface();
    virtual ~SubsystemInterface();
    // Out of line in retail: 0x00329F5E (row in subsystem/SubsystemInterfaceCopy.cpp); an
    // implicit copy would be emitted as a second COMDAT definition beside that row's.
    SubsystemInterface(const SubsystemInterface &that);
    // Out of line in retail: 0x00329880 (row in subsystem/SubsystemInterfaceCopy.cpp); the
    // implicit assignment would likewise be a second COMDAT definition.
    SubsystemInterface &operator=(const SubsystemInterface &that);
    // Out of line in retail: 0x0006F3CC (row in subsystem/SubsystemInterfaceSetName.cpp).
    void setName(AsciiString name);
    bool m_flag;
    AsciiString m_name;
};

#endif // CANONICAL_SUBSYSTEMINTERFACE_H
